Summary: Prophecy is God's word spoken through His chosen messengers to warn, comfort, and reveal His plans, including promises fulfilled in Jesus. True prophecy always agrees with God's character and often calls His people back to covenant faithfulness. Studying prophecy helps believers recognize Christ in all Scripture and live in readiness for what God has promised.
KeyPassages: Deuteronomy 18:18-22; Isaiah 53; Micah 5:2; Amos 3:7; Luke 24:27; 2 Peter 1:20-21
RelatedPeople: Moses; Isaiah; Jeremiah; Ezekiel; Micah; Jesus
RelatedDoctrines: Prophecy; Inspiration of Scripture; Messianic Prophecy
RelatedQuestions: How can we tell true prophecy from false prophecy?; Which prophecies did Jesus fulfill?
